### Claude · 2026-05-28 08:42

Sí, hay varias formas. La más sencilla:

**Opción 1 — Compartir archivo directamente (más rápido)**
Tu compañera en Figma abre el archivo → botón **Share** arriba a la derecha → escribe tu email → te da permisos de edición. Tú recibes el link y me lo pegas aquí.

**Opción 2 — Team en Figma (mejor para trabajo continuo)**
Ella crea un **Team** en Figma, te invita, y todos los archivos del equipo son accesibles para ambos. Así no hay que compartir archivo por archivo.

**Para trabajar con Claude Code en paralelo:**
Cada uno tendría el link del mismo archivo y podría pedirme cosas sobre él desde su terminal. Lo importante es que ambos tengan permisos de edición en el archivo.

¿Qué opción te encaja mejor? Si ya tienes el link del archivo de tu compañera, puedes empezar ahora mismo.

### Claude · 2026-05-28 08:43

Sencillo:

**¿Qué son los tokens?**
Unidades de texto. Aproximadamente 1 token = 4 caracteres. Tanto lo que tú escribes como lo que yo respondo consume tokens.

**¿Cómo se gasta?**
- Mensaje corto tuyo → pocos tokens
- Archivo de código largo que me mandas → muchos tokens
- Respuesta mía larga → muchos tokens
- Trabajar con archivos de Figma grandes → bastantes tokens

**En tu plan (Claude Team):**
Tienes un límite mensual. Claude Code te avisará si te estás acercando al límite. No hay que obsesionarse, pero sí tener en cuenta que tareas grandes (analizar un proyecto entero, generar muchos diseños seguidos) gastan más.

**Consejo práctico:**
Sé específico en tus peticiones. En vez de "analiza todo mi proyecto", mejor "analiza este componente". Menos contexto innecesario = menos tokens gastados.

¿Tienes alguna duda más concreta sobre los tokens?

## Reglas técnicas críticas
1. **NUNCA** poner fills en nodos INSTANCE (crea rectángulo sólido encima del icono) — siempre en el VECTOR interior
2. Usar `fills = []` para sin relleno, NUNCA `opacity:0` (crea ghost fills visibles en el panel de Figma)
3. Variantes de ComponentSet: formato obligatorio `"Property=Value, Property2=Value2"`
4. Después de `combineAsVariants`, posicionar cada variante manualmente y llamar a `set.resize()`
5. Instancias cross-page: `figma.getNodeById(id)` funciona entre páginas

como veo las variables en el figma

### Claude · 2026-05-28 09:04

En Figma desktop o web, hay dos formas:

**Opción 1 — Panel de variables**
- Menú superior: **Edit → Variables** (o **Local variables**)
- Atajo de teclado: no hay uno directo, pero puedes ir desde el panel derecho

**Opción 2 — Desde el canvas (más rápido)**
1. Haz clic en cualquier parte vacía del canvas para deseleccionar todo
2. En el panel derecho verás el botón **"Local variables"** o un icono de colecciones
3. Se abre el panel con todas las colecciones: `01 · Primitivos`, `04 · Semánticos`, etc.

**Para ver las nuevas:**
- Busca la colección `01 · Primitivos` → verás los nuevos `orange/`, `green/`, `blue/`
- Busca `04 · Semánticos` → verás los nuevos `semantic/pending-amount`, `chart/...`, `ticker/bg`
- Cambia entre modo **Light** y **Dark** con el selector de modos en la parte superior del panel

¿Las ves correctamente?

### Antonio · 2026-05-28 09:06

como se llama lo que has creado ahora para poder distinguirlo bien?

### Claude · 2026-05-28 09:06

Lo que he creado son **Variables de Figma** (también llamadas **Design Tokens**).

Son la base del sistema de diseño — definen los valores reutilizables (colores, espaciados, radios) de forma centralizada. Cuando un componente usa una variable en vez de un color hardcodeado, al cambiar la variable se actualiza automáticamente en todos los sitios donde se usa.

**Estructura que hemos creado:**

- **Primitivos** → los valores raw (`orange/500 = #f97316`). No se aplican directamente en diseño.
- **Semánticos** → el significado (`semantic/pending-amount`). Estos sí se usan en componentes — y apuntan a un primitivo por debajo.

En el panel de Figma se llama **"Local variables"** y están organizadas por colecciones. Las tuyas están en `01 · Primitivos` y `04 · Semánticos`.

### Claude · 2026-05-28 12:02

Razón. Antes de seguir construyendo hay que pensar en la arquitectura correcta. Lo que tienes ahora es un sidebar monolítico — hay que descomponerlo en átomos reales.

---

**La jerarquía atómica que necesita el Sidebar:**

```
Atom:     NavItem   →  State = Default / Hover / Active
                        Collapsed = false / true
                        Props: icon (swap), label (text)

Molecule: NavGroup  →  lista de NavItems compuestos

Organism: Navigation/Sidebar
            ├─ logo + toggle
            ├─ search
            ├─ NavGroup (primary)
            ├─ separator
            ├─ NavGroup (secondary)
            └─ footer user
```

**Por qué importa:**

- El `NavItem` con `State=Hover` necesita su propia interacción (`On Hover → change to Hover`)
- El `NavItem` con `State=Active` es el que se usa en el frame de la página que está activa
- Cada pantalla del prototipo (Overview, Students, Cohorts…) tendrá su propio sidebar con el item correcto en Active — no un prop `ActiveItem` con 28 variantes
- Al ser un átomo reutilizable, también sirve en menús móviles, tabs de admin, drawer secundario, etc.

**Flujo de prototipo resultante:**
```
NavItem(Default) ──onHover──→ NavItem(Hover)
NavItem(Hover)   ──onClick──→ Frame:PantallaPagos  (o la que sea)
NavItem(Hover)   ──offHover──→ NavItem(Default)
```

---

   - Icon vector fills: found via `instance.findOne(n => n.type === "VECTOR").fills`
   - Auto-layout icon slot with `layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` on inner icon instance

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **ON_CLICK reactions initially pointed to screen frames**: User said "no quiero que esten conectados a screens, quiero que esten conectados entre ellos". Fixed by changing from `NAVIGATE` to screen frames to `CHANGE_TO` sidebar variants.

   - **Screenshot sibling bleed**: `contentsOnly: false` (default) includes adjacent nodes. Fixed with `contentsOnly: true`.
   - **`addComponentProperty` INSTANCE_SWAP fails with key format**: Error "Property value is incompatible with component property type" when using 40-char hex component key. Fixed: use NODE ID string format ("815:277") instead.
   - **`importComponentByKeyAsync` fails for same-file components**: Error "Component with key not found". Expected behavior — this API is for cross-file library components only. Local components use `getNodeByIdAsync`.
   - **Icon fills were background fills, not vector fills**: Setting `icon.fills = [paint]` sets background. Fixed: find `icon.findOne(n => n.type === "VECTOR").fills = [paint]`.
   - **`swapComponent` resets size**: After swap, instance returns to native size. Must call `resize(16,16)` after every `swapComponent`.
   - **Wrong icon ID 607:1017**: Used incorrect ID (some circle arrow). Correct ArrowLeft Regular is `607:1027`.
   - **Icons visually different size even at 16×16**: ArrowLeft designed for 32px renders with thin strokes at 16px. ArrowRight designed for 16px has correct weight. Solution: use auto-layout slot with FILL sizing for inner icon.
   - **"Can only set component property references on symbol sublayer"**: Error when trying to set `componentPropertyReferences` on a freshly created frame inserted into a component variant. Can only set refs on existing tracked sublayers of a component. Current workaround: must modify existing slots in-place rather than remove+insert.
   - **Responded in Italian**: User asked "xq me estas hablando en italiano". Fixed by responding in Spanish.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Atomic design**: Sidebar interactions moved into the organism (not the atom). NavItem is "dumb", sidebar manages all state changes.
   - **14 sidebar variants** handle all combinations of ActiveSection (7) × Collapsed (2)
   - **INSTANCE_SWAP for local components**: Discovered that node ID format ("815:277") works as defaultValue for `addComponentProperty` INSTANCE_SWAP, while the component key (hex) does not
   - **Icon size consistency**: The core problem is native icon sizes differ across Phosphor. The solution being implemented is auto-layout icon slot with FILL sizing on inner instance, so ANY icon stretches to 16×16 regardless of native size
   - **CURRENT BLOCKER**: The `rebuildSlot` function approach (remove old frame, insert new auto-layout frame) fails because newly created nodes can't have `componentPropertyReferences` set when inserted into a component variant. 8. Current Work:
   Working on the Button component set (ID: `1601:790`) rebuilding icon slots so that inner icon instances truly fill to 16×16. The last attempt used a `rebuildSlot` function that removed existing slot frames and inserted new auto-layout frames, but failed with:
   ```
   Error: in set_componentPropertyReferences: Can only set component property references on symbol sublayer
   ```
   
   The approach of removing and inserting new frames into component variants does not work. The correct approach is to modify the EXISTING slot frames in-place:
   - Change `slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL"` 
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`, `slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`, `slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`
   - Set inner instance: `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"`, `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"`

   The Button component set structure:
   - 12 variants: Type=Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Danger × State=Default/Hover/Disabled
   - Each variant children: `icon-left` (slot, 16×16) → `label` → `icon-right` (slot, 16×16)
   - Slot children[0] = icon instance

9. Optional Next Step:
   Fix the icon slots in-place by modifying existing slot frames to auto-layout with FILL sizing for the inner icon instance. The user's last message was "el frame si pero el icono interior no" confirming the outer 16×16 slot is correct but the inner icon instance is not filling to that size.

   The fix: iterate all variants, find each `icon-left` and `icon-right` slot, convert them to auto-layout in-place (without removing/reinserting), and set `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` and `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"` on the inner instance. This avoids the "symbol sublayer" error since we're modifying existing nodes, not creating new ones.

   ```javascript
   // For each variant in compSet.children:
   const slot = variant.findOne(n => n.name === "icon-left");
   const inst = slot.children[0];
   
   // Convert slot to auto-layout in-place
   slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL";
   slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.itemSpacing = 0;
   slot.paddingLeft = slot.paddingRight = slot.paddingTop = slot.paddingBottom = 0;
   
   // Make inner icon fill the slot
   inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL";
   inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL";
   ```

Anotado como principio rector. Lo que implica en la práctica:

**Escala atómica que seguiremos:**
- **Átomos** — Button, Input, Badge, Avatar, Icon (ya hechos)
- **Moléculas** — Filter/Chip (átomo+texto+número), Card/stat (label+valor+sublabel)
- **Organismos** — Navigation/Sidebar, Table (Header+Row), la banda de KPIs, el topbar
- **Templates** — La pantalla de Pagos ensamblada con instancias

**Lo que esto me obliga a hacer siempre:**
1. Cualquier cambio visual → modificar el **componente**, no la pantalla
2. Cualquier nuevo elemento en la pantalla → primero existe como componente, luego se instancia
3. El feedback de diseño entra por abajo (átomo) y sube, nunca al revés

**Lo que todavía queda sin atomizar en el preview actual:**
- `metrics-band` (FRAME raw) → debería ser un organismo **KPI/Band**
- `action-buttons` (FRAME raw) → podría ser una molécula **Table/Toolbar**
- `eyebrow` (TEXT raw) → contenido de página, aceptable como raw

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Building a comprehensive atomic design system in Figma (file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` ID: 1405:3) for "Atlas" — a finance admin app for managing student payments. The user wants all components built atomically (atoms → molecules → organisms → templates), all changes made at the component level (never in the screen directly), and the Preview/Payments screen assembled entirely from component instances. The user also wants Smart Animate prototyping for interactions and acted as product owner giving incremental feedback.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Figma Plugin API** via `use_figma` (fileKey: `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`)
   - **Atomic Design** — atoms (Button, Input, Badge, Avatar), molecules (Card/stat, KPI/Hero, Table/Toolbar), organisms (Navigation/Sidebar, KPI/Band, Table/FilterBar, Table/HeaderRow)
   - **`combineAsVariants([comp1, comp2, ...], page)`** — creates COMPONENT_SET
   - **`appendChild`** — adding COMPONENT nodes directly to COMPONENT_SET
   - **`componentPropertyReferences`** — must be set AFTER `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET
   - **TEXT properties** — wiring text nodes to component properties; shared property default overrides all variants, so static text is often better
   - **`setProperties()`** — overrides component properties on instances
   - **Smart Animate reactions** — `ON_HOVER`/`ON_CLICK` with `CHANGE_TO`, `SMART_ANIMATE`, `EASE_OUT`
   - **`createComponentFromNode(frame)`** — converts frame to COMPONENT
   - **INSTANCE_SWAP** — uses node ID format ("815:277"), NOT hex component key
   - **Auto-layout FILL sizing** — `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` requires parent to be auto-layout and node to already be a child
   - **Icon slots** — 16×16 auto-layout frames with `clipsContent: true`, inner icon instance with FILL sizing

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **Figma file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` (ID: 1405:3)**

   **Smart Animate reactions pattern:**
   ```js
   function react(trigger, targetId, durationS) {
     return {
       trigger: { type: trigger }, // "ON_HOVER" or "ON_CLICK"
       actions: [{
         type: "NODE",
         destinationId: targetId,
         navigation: "CHANGE_TO",
         transition: { type: "SMART_ANIMATE", easing: { type: "EASE_OUT" }, duration: durationS },
         preserveScrollPosition: false,
       }]
     };
   }
   node.reactions = [...node.reactions, react("ON_HOVER", targetId, 0.20)];
   ```

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **`combineAsVariants` fails with FRAME nodes**: Only accepts COMPONENT nodes → Fixed: use `figma.createComponent()` or `figma.createComponentFromNode(frame)` before combining
   - **`componentPropertyReferences` throws "Can only set on symbol sublayer"**: Setting refs before `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET → Fixed: always `appendChild` first, then set `componentPropertyReferences`
   - **TEXT property overrides all variant text to same default**: Wiring `characters` to a shared property key makes all variants show the property default → Fixed: unlink (`componentPropertyReferences = {}`) and set static text per variant; for instances use `setProperties()` after component is in set
   - **`layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` fails**: Node must be a child of auto-layout frame → Fixed: `appendChild` to auto-layout parent first, then set FILL
   - **`node.cornerRadius` / `node.layoutMode` throws on TEXT nodes**: Not all properties exist on all node types → Fixed: use `'layoutMode' in node` type guards or handle TEXT separately
   - **`combineAsVariants` consumes nodes from old set, making `oldSet.remove()` fail**: The old COMPONENT_SET is already gone → Fixed: don't call `remove()` after `combineAsVariants`
   - **`clone()` of Card/stat variants in combineAsVariants approach**: Clones were added to page but combineAsVariants didn't include them properly → Fixed: use `appendChild` on existing COMPONENT_SET instead of combineAsVariants
   - **Filter/Chip chips all showing "Pagados 893"**: `setProperties()` on instances not working because TEXT property not wired to text nodes → Fixed: wire `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: labelKey }` on text nodes in source variants, then use `setProperties()`
   - **User feedback**: "estas haciendo los cambios en la screen pero no en los componentes que es lo mas importante" → Always update the component first, then the screen reflects through instances
   - **User feedback on animations**: "no me gusta, no quiero que haya nada on click solo algo como hover para que el numero se agrande" → Removed Active state and ON_CLICK reactions from Card/stat, kept only ON_HOVER
   - **User feedback on hover subtlety**: "podemos hacerlo mas sutil?" with instruction to act as senior designer → Changed from 26→32px jump to: value 26→28px (+2px), label dims (0.4→0.30), sublabel brightens (0.38→0.52), 200ms duration

Ahora lo tengo todo claro. La lógica de filtrado del código:

```
matchesStatus(row, chip):
  "todos"      → muestra todo
  "pagados"    → cobrado > 0  AND  pendiente === 0
  "pendientes" → pendiente > 0
  "vencidos"   → placeholder (devuelve false, necesita lógica de fechas)
```

---

**El problema para Figma:** Figma no puede filtrar datos reales. Pero sí podemos **prototipar la interacción** de forma convincente.

La solución es crear **4 frames de tabla** — uno por cada estado del filtro — con las filas correctas según la lógica, y conectarlos con Smart Animate en los chips:

| Chip activo | Filas visibles |
|---|---|
| Todos | 5 filas mixtas |
| Pagados | Solo filas con badge "Pagado" |
| Pendientes | Solo filas con badge "Pendiente" |
| Vencidos | 0 filas (o 1 ejemplo) |

Para hacerlo bien a nivel atómico, primero necesito actualizar el componente `Filter/Chip` para que coincida con la referencia (negro activo, punto de color, pill shape), y luego montar los 4 estados de tabla.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The session covered multiple tasks on Figma file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` (ID: 1405:3):
   - **Click navigation**: Wire NavItem clicks in Navigation/Sidebar v2 to use `CHANGE_TO` between sidebar variants (NOT navigate to external screen frames)
   - **Delete screen frames**: Screens will live on a separate page — remove the 7 temporary screen frames from this page
   - **Toggle collapse**: Create 7 `Collapsed=True` sidebar variants and wire toggle buttons between expanded↔collapsed
   - **Preview screen**: Create a preview frame showing the sidebar
   - **Atomic design for all components**: Every component needs all its variant states — the Button was specifically called out as needing all types × states
   - **Button rebuild**: "empieza por el button, hazlo con iconos a los lados y que se puedan ocultar y cambiar por otros de phosphor como el texto" — icons must be: hideable via boolean, swappable via INSTANCE_SWAP, same size on both sides, color automatic (white on dark bg, dark on light bg)

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Figma Plugin API via `use_figma` (fileKey: `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page: `componentes v2`, ID: `1405:3`)
   - **CRITICAL**: `INSTANCE_SWAP` in `addComponentProperty` requires NODE ID format ("815:277"), NOT component key (40-char hex) for local components
   - `combineAsVariants([comp1, comp2, ...], page)` to create COMPONENT_SET
   - `inst.reactions = [...existing, newReaction]` — merge reactions, don't replace
   - `ON_HOVER` trigger for hover states (auto-reverts on mouse leave)
   - `CHANGE_TO` navigation for switching between component variants
   - `NAVIGATE` for navigating to external frames (not used for sidebar)
   - `actions: [...]` array (not `action:`) in reaction objects
   - `addComponentProperty` returns a key string like `"Label#1602:0"`
   - `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: labelKey }` for TEXT, `{ visible: boolKey }` for BOOLEAN, `{ mainComponent: swapKey }` for INSTANCE_SWAP
   - `swapComponent(targetComp)` resets instance size — must call `resize()` after
   - Icon vector fills: found via `instance.findOne(n => n.type === "VECTOR").fills`

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **ON_CLICK reactions initially pointed to screen frames**: User said "no quiero que esten conectados a screens, quiero que esten conectados entre ellos". Fixed by changing from `NAVIGATE` to screen frames to `CHANGE_TO` sidebar variants.

   - **Screenshot sibling bleed**: `contentsOnly: false` (default) includes adjacent nodes. Fixed with `contentsOnly: true`.
   - **`addComponentProperty` INSTANCE_SWAP fails with key format**: Error "Property value is incompatible with component property type" when using 40-char hex component key. Fixed: use NODE ID string format ("815:277") instead.
   - **`importComponentByKeyAsync` fails for same-file components**: Error "Component with key not found". Expected behavior — this API is for cross-file library components only. Local components use `getNodeByIdAsync`.
   - **Icon fills were background fills, not vector fills**: Setting `icon.fills = [paint]` sets background. Fixed: find `icon.findOne(n => n.type === "VECTOR").fills = [paint]`.
   - **`swapComponent` resets size**: After swap, instance returns to native size. Must call `resize(16,16)` after every `swapComponent`.
   - **Wrong icon ID 607:1017**: Used incorrect ID (some circle arrow). Correct ArrowLeft Regular is `607:1027`.
   - **Icons visually different size even at 16×16**: ArrowLeft designed for 32px renders with thin strokes at 16px. ArrowRight designed for 16px has correct weight. Solution: use auto-layout slot with FILL sizing for inner icon.
   - **"Can only set component property references on symbol sublayer"**: Error when trying to set `componentPropertyReferences` on a freshly created frame inserted into a component variant. Can only set refs on existing tracked sublayers of a component. Current workaround: must modify existing slots in-place rather than remove+insert.
   - **Responded in Italian**: User asked "xq me estas hablando en italiano". Fixed by responding in Spanish.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Atomic design**: Sidebar interactions moved into the organism (not the atom). NavItem is "dumb", sidebar manages all state changes.
   - **14 sidebar variants** handle all combinations of ActiveSection (7) × Collapsed (2)
   - **INSTANCE_SWAP for local components**: Discovered that node ID format ("815:277") works as defaultValue for `addComponentProperty` INSTANCE_SWAP, while the component key (hex) does not
   - **Icon size consistency**: The core problem is native icon sizes differ across Phosphor. The solution being implemented is auto-layout icon slot with FILL sizing on inner instance, so ANY icon stretches to 16×16 regardless of native size
   - **CURRENT BLOCKER**: The `rebuildSlot` function approach (remove old frame, insert new auto-layout frame) fails because newly created nodes can't have `componentPropertyReferences` set when inserted into a component variant. 8. Current Work:
   Working on the Button component set (ID: `1601:790`) rebuilding icon slots so that inner icon instances truly fill to 16×16. The last attempt used a `rebuildSlot` function that removed existing slot frames and inserted new auto-layout frames, but failed with:
   ```
   Error: in set_componentPropertyReferences: Can only set component property references on symbol sublayer
   ```
   
   The approach of removing and inserting new frames into component variants does not work. The correct approach is to modify the EXISTING slot frames in-place:
   - Change `slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL"` 
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`, `slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`, `slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`
   - Set inner instance: `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"`, `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"`

   The Button component set structure:
   - 12 variants: Type=Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Danger × State=Default/Hover/Disabled
   - Each variant children: `icon-left` (slot, 16×16) → `label` → `icon-right` (slot, 16×16)
   - Slot children[0] = icon instance

9. Optional Next Step:
   Fix the icon slots in-place by modifying existing slot frames to auto-layout with FILL sizing for the inner icon instance. The user's last message was "el frame si pero el icono interior no" confirming the outer 16×16 slot is correct but the inner icon instance is not filling to that size.

   The fix: iterate all variants, find each `icon-left` and `icon-right` slot, convert them to auto-layout in-place (without removing/reinserting), and set `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` and `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"` on the inner instance. This avoids the "symbol sublayer" error since we're modifying existing nodes, not creating new ones.

   ```javascript
   // For each variant in compSet.children:
   const slot = variant.findOne(n => n.name === "icon-left");
   const inst = slot.children[0];
   
   // Convert slot to auto-layout in-place
   slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL";
   slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.itemSpacing = 0;
   slot.paddingLeft = slot.paddingRight = slot.paddingTop = slot.paddingBottom = 0;
   
   // Make inner icon fill the slot
   inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL";
   inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL";
   ```

### Antonio · 2026-05-29 07:18

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Building a comprehensive atomic design system in Figma (file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` ID: 1405:3) for "Atlas" — a finance admin app for managing student payments. The user wants all components built atomically (atoms → molecules → organisms → templates), all changes made at the component level (never in the screen directly), and the Preview/Payments screen assembled entirely from component instances. The user also wants Smart Animate prototyping for interactions and acted as product owner giving incremental feedback.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Figma Plugin API** via `use_figma` (fileKey: `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`)
   - **Atomic Design** — atoms (Button, Input, Badge, Avatar), molecules (Card/stat, KPI/Hero, Table/Toolbar), organisms (Navigation/Sidebar, KPI/Band, Table/FilterBar, Table/HeaderRow)
   - **`combineAsVariants([comp1, comp2, ...], page)`** — creates COMPONENT_SET
   - **`appendChild`** — adding COMPONENT nodes directly to COMPONENT_SET
   - **`componentPropertyReferences`** — must be set AFTER `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET
   - **TEXT properties** — wiring text nodes to component properties; shared property default overrides all variants, so static text is often better
   - **`setProperties()`** — overrides component properties on instances
   - **Smart Animate reactions** — `ON_HOVER`/`ON_CLICK` with `CHANGE_TO`, `SMART_ANIMATE`, `EASE_OUT`
   - **`createComponentFromNode(frame)`** — converts frame to COMPONENT
   - **INSTANCE_SWAP** — uses node ID format ("815:277"), NOT hex component key
   - **Auto-layout FILL sizing** — `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` requires parent to be auto-layout and node to already be a child
   - **Icon slots** — 16×16 auto-layout frames with `clipsContent: true`, inner icon instance with FILL sizing

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **Figma file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` (ID: 1405:3)**
     - All components and the preview screen live here
   
   **Component IDs and structures:**
   - Button COMPONENT_SET: `1601:790` — 12 variants (Type=Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Danger × State=Default/Hover/Disabled), icon slots 16×16 with auto-layout FILL, INSTANCE_SWAP properties for left/right icons
   - Input COMPONENT_SET: `1616:677` — 5 variants, each has VERTICAL auto-layout wrapper with label+field+helper, field is 320×48px cornerRadius 10
   - Badge/PaymentStatus: `1430:12` — 5 color variants (Pendiente/Pagado/Vencido/Parcial/Cancelado)
   - Filter/Chip: `1431:9` — 5 variants (Active/Inactive/Active Hover/Inactive Hover/Disabled), TEXT props: `Label#1431:4`, `Count#1431:5`
   - Card/stat: `1669:575` — 6 variants (Variant=Cobrado/Pendiente/Placeholder × State=Default/Hover), 320×120px, transparent bg, padding 24px, value 26px→28px on hover
   - KPI/Hero: `1670:559` — single component (label 11px, number 80px Bold, sublabel 13px), TEXT props: Label/Value/Sublabel
   - Avatar/Initials: `1648:420` — 5 color variants (Gray/Teal/Amber/Purple/Blue), 40×40px cornerRadius 9999
   - Table/HeaderRow: `1641:636` — 3 variants (Default/Sort Asc/Sort Desc), 1080×56px
   - Table/DataRow: `1640:653` — 3 variants (Default/Hover #EFEFEF/Selected teal wash + 3px accent bar), 1080×80px
   - Navigation/Sidebar v2: `1527:820` — 14 variants (7 expanded 220px × 7 collapsed 56px), separated into 2 rows
   - KPI/Band: `1684:587` — organism, 1124×120px, bg #F9F9F8, cornerRadius 16, 3 Card/stat instances + 2 dividers
   - Table/Toolbar: `1684:602` — molecule, Button(Secondary "Filtros") + Button(Primary "Registrar pago"), gap 12px
   - Table/FilterBar: `1694:605` — organism, 6 Filter/Chip instances: Todos(1095, Active), Pagados(893), Pendientes(12), Vencidos(156), Parciales(24), Cancelados(10)

   **Preview/Payments screen:**
   - Screen frame: `1563:661` (1440×1112px)
   - Content frame: `1563:718` (1220×1112px at x=220)

   - Sidebar: instance of `Navigation/Sidebar v2` Payments+Expanded variant at x=0

   **Smart Animate reactions pattern:**
   ```js
   function react(trigger, targetId, durationS) {
     return {
       trigger: { type: trigger }, // "ON_HOVER" or "ON_CLICK"
       actions: [{
         type: "NODE",
         destinationId: targetId,
         navigation: "CHANGE_TO",
         transition: { type: "SMART_ANIMATE", easing: { type: "EASE_OUT" }, duration: durationS },
         preserveScrollPosition: false,
       }]
     };
   }
   node.reactions = [...node.reactions, react("ON_HOVER", targetId, 0.20)];
   ```

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **`combineAsVariants` fails with FRAME nodes**: Only accepts COMPONENT nodes → Fixed: use `figma.createComponent()` or `figma.createComponentFromNode(frame)` before combining
   - **`componentPropertyReferences` throws "Can only set on symbol sublayer"**: Setting refs before `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET → Fixed: always `appendChild` first, then set `componentPropertyReferences`
   - **TEXT property overrides all variant text to same default**: Wiring `characters` to a shared property key makes all variants show the property default → Fixed: unlink (`componentPropertyReferences = {}`) and set static text per variant; for instances use `setProperties()` after component is in set
   - **`layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` fails**: Node must be a child of auto-layout frame → Fixed: `appendChild` to auto-layout parent first, then set FILL
   - **`node.cornerRadius` / `node.layoutMode` throws on TEXT nodes**: Not all properties exist on all node types → Fixed: use `'layoutMode' in node` type guards or handle TEXT separately
   - **`combineAsVariants` consumes nodes from old set, making `oldSet.remove()` fail**: The old COMPONENT_SET is already gone → Fixed: don't call `remove()` after `combineAsVariants`
   - **`clone()` of Card/stat variants in combineAsVariants approach**: Clones were added to page but combineAsVariants didn't include them properly → Fixed: use `appendChild` on existing COMPONENT_SET instead of combineAsVariants
   - **Filter/Chip chips all showing "Pagados 893"**: `setProperties()` on instances not working because TEXT property not wired to text nodes → Fixed: wire `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: labelKey }` on text nodes in source variants, then use `setProperties()`
   - **User feedback**: "estas haciendo los cambios en la screen pero no en los componentes que es lo mas importante" → Always update the component first, then the screen reflects through instances
   - **User feedback on animations**: "no me gusta, no quiero que haya nada on click solo algo como hover para que el numero se agrande" → Removed Active state and ON_CLICK reactions from Card/stat, kept only ON_HOVER
   - **User feedback on hover subtlety**: "podemos hacerlo mas sutil?" with instruction to act as senior designer → Changed from 26→32px jump to: value 26→28px (+2px), label dims (0.4→0.30), sublabel brightens (0.38→0.52), 200ms duration

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Atomic design enforcement**: Created separate component for every reusable element; screen uses 100% component instances. When user pointed out raw frames in screen, created KPI/Band organism and Table/Toolbar molecule to replace them.
   - **Card/stat evolution**: Started as flat 3-variant set → added TEXT properties → removed Matriculaciones variant (moved to dedicated KPI/Hero) → added State axis (Default/Hover) → redesigned hover to be ultra-subtle per senior designer principles
   - **Filter/Chip text wiring**: The chips' Label/Count TEXT properties existed on the component set but were not wired to text nodes. Had to explicitly set `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: key }` on text nodes in ALL chip variants, then `setProperties()` works on instances.
   - **Sidebar layout**: Collapsed variants were overlapping expanded ones at same x,y coordinates. Fixed by separating into 2 rows (expanded at y=PAD, collapsed at y=PAD+800+GAP).

### Claude · 2026-05-29 07:29

Ahora lo tengo todo claro. La lógica de filtrado del código:

```
matchesStatus(row, chip):
  "todos"      → muestra todo
  "pagados"    → cobrado > 0  AND  pendiente === 0
  "pendientes" → pendiente > 0
  "vencidos"   → placeholder (devuelve false, necesita lógica de fechas)
```

---

**El problema para Figma:** Figma no puede filtrar datos reales. Pero sí podemos **prototipar la interacción** de forma convincente.

La solución es crear **4 frames de tabla** — uno por cada estado del filtro — con las filas correctas según la lógica, y conectarlos con Smart Animate en los chips:

| Chip activo | Filas visibles |
|---|---|
| Todos | 5 filas mixtas |
| Pagados | Solo filas con badge "Pagado" |
| Pendientes | Solo filas con badge "Pendiente" |
| Vencidos | 0 filas (o 1 ejemplo) |

Para hacerlo bien a nivel atómico, primero necesito actualizar el componente `Filter/Chip` para que coincida con la referencia (negro activo, punto de color, pill shape), y luego montar los 4 estados de tabla.

   ```
   Error: in set_componentPropertyReferences: Can only set component property references on symbol sublayer
   ```
   
   The approach of removing and inserting new frames into component variants does not work. The correct approach is to modify the EXISTING slot frames in-place:
   - Change `slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL"` 
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`, `slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"`
   - Set `slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`, `slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER"`
   - Set inner instance: `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"`, `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"`

   The Button component set structure:
   - 12 variants: Type=Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Danger × State=Default/Hover/Disabled

9. Optional Next Step:
   Fix the icon slots in-place by modifying existing slot frames to auto-layout with FILL sizing for the inner icon instance. The user's last message was "el frame si pero el icono interior no" confirming the outer 16×16 slot is correct but the inner icon instance is not filling to that size.

   The fix: iterate all variants, find each `icon-left` and `icon-right` slot, convert them to auto-layout in-place (without removing/reinserting), and set `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` and `inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL"` on the inner instance. This avoids the "symbol sublayer" error since we're modifying existing nodes, not creating new ones.

   ```javascript
   // For each variant in compSet.children:
   const slot = variant.findOne(n => n.name === "icon-left");
   const inst = slot.children[0];
   
   // Convert slot to auto-layout in-place
   slot.layoutMode = "HORIZONTAL";
   slot.primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED";
   slot.primaryAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.counterAxisAlignItems = "CENTER";
   slot.itemSpacing = 0;
   slot.paddingLeft = slot.paddingRight = slot.paddingTop = slot.paddingBottom = 0;
   
   // Make inner icon fill the slot
   inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL";
   inst.layoutSizingVertical = "FILL";
   ```

Anotado como principio rector. Lo que implica en la práctica:

**Escala atómica que seguiremos:**
- **Átomos** — Button, Input, Badge, Avatar, Icon (ya hechos)
- **Moléculas** — Filter/Chip (átomo+texto+número), Card/stat (label+valor+sublabel)
- **Organismos** — Navigation/Sidebar, Table (Header+Row), la banda de KPIs, el topbar
- **Templates** — La pantalla de Pagos ensamblada con instancias

**Lo que esto me obliga a hacer siempre:**
1. Cualquier cambio visual → modificar el **componente**, no la pantalla
2. Cualquier nuevo elemento en la pantalla → primero existe como componente, luego se instancia
3. El feedback de diseño entra por abajo (átomo) y sube, nunca al revés

**Lo que todavía queda sin atomizar en el preview actual:**
- `metrics-band` (FRAME raw) → debería ser un organismo **KPI/Band**
- `action-buttons` (FRAME raw) → podría ser una molécula **Table/Toolbar**
- `eyebrow` (TEXT raw) → contenido de página, aceptable como raw

### Antonio · 2026-05-29 07:18

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Building a comprehensive atomic design system in Figma (file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` ID: 1405:3) for "Atlas" — a finance admin app for managing student payments. The user wants all components built atomically (atoms → molecules → organisms → templates), all changes made at the component level (never in the screen directly), and the Preview/Payments screen assembled entirely from component instances. The user also wants Smart Animate prototyping for interactions and acted as product owner giving incremental feedback.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Figma Plugin API** via `use_figma` (fileKey: `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`)
   - **Atomic Design** — atoms (Button, Input, Badge, Avatar), molecules (Card/stat, KPI/Hero, Table/Toolbar), organisms (Navigation/Sidebar, KPI/Band, Table/FilterBar, Table/HeaderRow)
   - **`combineAsVariants([comp1, comp2, ...], page)`** — creates COMPONENT_SET
   - **`appendChild`** — adding COMPONENT nodes directly to COMPONENT_SET
   - **`componentPropertyReferences`** — must be set AFTER `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET
   - **TEXT properties** — wiring text nodes to component properties; shared property default overrides all variants, so static text is often better
   - **`setProperties()`** — overrides component properties on instances
   - **Smart Animate reactions** — `ON_HOVER`/`ON_CLICK` with `CHANGE_TO`, `SMART_ANIMATE`, `EASE_OUT`
   - **`createComponentFromNode(frame)`** — converts frame to COMPONENT
   - **INSTANCE_SWAP** — uses node ID format ("815:277"), NOT hex component key
   - **Auto-layout FILL sizing** — `inst.layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` requires parent to be auto-layout and node to already be a child
   - **Icon slots** — 16×16 auto-layout frames with `clipsContent: true`, inner icon instance with FILL sizing

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **Figma file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page `componentes v2` (ID: 1405:3)**
     - All components and the preview screen live here
   
   **Component IDs and structures:**
   - Button COMPONENT_SET: `1601:790` — 12 variants (Type=Primary/Secondary/Ghost/Danger × State=Default/Hover/Disabled), icon slots 16×16 with auto-layout FILL, INSTANCE_SWAP properties for left/right icons
   - Input COMPONENT_SET: `1616:677` — 5 variants, each has VERTICAL auto-layout wrapper with label+field+helper, field is 320×48px cornerRadius 10
   - Badge/PaymentStatus: `1430:12` — 5 color variants (Pendiente/Pagado/Vencido/Parcial/Cancelado)
   - Filter/Chip: `1431:9` — 5 variants (Active/Inactive/Active Hover/Inactive Hover/Disabled), TEXT props: `Label#1431:4`, `Count#1431:5`
   - Card/stat: `1669:575` — 6 variants (Variant=Cobrado/Pendiente/Placeholder × State=Default/Hover), 320×120px, transparent bg, padding 24px, value 26px→28px on hover
   - KPI/Hero: `1670:559` — single component (label 11px, number 80px Bold, sublabel 13px), TEXT props: Label/Value/Sublabel
   - Avatar/Initials: `1648:420` — 5 color variants (Gray/Teal/Amber/Purple/Blue), 40×40px cornerRadius 9999
   - Table/HeaderRow: `1641:636` — 3 variants (Default/Sort Asc/Sort Desc), 1080×56px
   - Table/DataRow: `1640:653` — 3 variants (Default/Hover #EFEFEF/Selected teal wash + 3px accent bar), 1080×80px

   - KPI/Band: `1684:587` — organism, 1124×120px, bg #F9F9F8, cornerRadius 16, 3 Card/stat instances + 2 dividers

   - Table/FilterBar: `1694:605` — organism, 6 Filter/Chip instances: Todos(1095, Active), Pagados(893), Pendientes(12), Vencidos(156), Parciales(24), Cancelados(10)

   - Sidebar: instance of `Navigation/Sidebar v2` Payments+Expanded variant at x=0

   **Smart Animate reactions pattern:**
   ```js
   function react(trigger, targetId, durationS) {
     return {
       trigger: { type: trigger }, // "ON_HOVER" or "ON_CLICK"
       actions: [{
         type: "NODE",
         destinationId: targetId,
         navigation: "CHANGE_TO",
         transition: { type: "SMART_ANIMATE", easing: { type: "EASE_OUT" }, duration: durationS },
         preserveScrollPosition: false,
       }]
     };
   }
   node.reactions = [...node.reactions, react("ON_HOVER", targetId, 0.20)];
   ```

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **`combineAsVariants` fails with FRAME nodes**: Only accepts COMPONENT nodes → Fixed: use `figma.createComponent()` or `figma.createComponentFromNode(frame)` before combining
   - **`componentPropertyReferences` throws "Can only set on symbol sublayer"**: Setting refs before `appendChild` to COMPONENT_SET → Fixed: always `appendChild` first, then set `componentPropertyReferences`
   - **TEXT property overrides all variant text to same default**: Wiring `characters` to a shared property key makes all variants show the property default → Fixed: unlink (`componentPropertyReferences = {}`) and set static text per variant; for instances use `setProperties()` after component is in set
   - **`layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` fails**: Node must be a child of auto-layout frame → Fixed: `appendChild` to auto-layout parent first, then set FILL
   - **`node.cornerRadius` / `node.layoutMode` throws on TEXT nodes**: Not all properties exist on all node types → Fixed: use `'layoutMode' in node` type guards or handle TEXT separately
   - **`combineAsVariants` consumes nodes from old set, making `oldSet.remove()` fail**: The old COMPONENT_SET is already gone → Fixed: don't call `remove()` after `combineAsVariants`
   - **`clone()` of Card/stat variants in combineAsVariants approach**: Clones were added to page but combineAsVariants didn't include them properly → Fixed: use `appendChild` on existing COMPONENT_SET instead of combineAsVariants
   - **Filter/Chip chips all showing "Pagados 893"**: `setProperties()` on instances not working because TEXT property not wired to text nodes → Fixed: wire `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: labelKey }` on text nodes in source variants, then use `setProperties()`
   - **User feedback**: "estas haciendo los cambios en la screen pero no en los componentes que es lo mas importante" → Always update the component first, then the screen reflects through instances
   - **User feedback on animations**: "no me gusta, no quiero que haya nada on click solo algo como hover para que el numero se agrande" → Removed Active state and ON_CLICK reactions from Card/stat, kept only ON_HOVER
   - **User feedback on hover subtlety**: "podemos hacerlo mas sutil?" with instruction to act as senior designer → Changed from 26→32px jump to: value 26→28px (+2px), label dims (0.4→0.30), sublabel brightens (0.38→0.52), 200ms duration

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Atomic design enforcement**: Created separate component for every reusable element; screen uses 100% component instances. When user pointed out raw frames in screen, created KPI/Band organism and Table/Toolbar molecule to replace them.
   - **Card/stat evolution**: Started as flat 3-variant set → added TEXT properties → removed Matriculaciones variant (moved to dedicated KPI/Hero) → added State axis (Default/Hover) → redesigned hover to be ultra-subtle per senior designer principles
   - **Filter/Chip text wiring**: The chips' Label/Count TEXT properties existed on the component set but were not wired to text nodes. Had to explicitly set `componentPropertyReferences = { characters: key }` on text nodes in ALL chip variants, then `setProperties()` works on instances.
   - **Sidebar layout**: Collapsed variants were overlapping expanded ones at same x,y coordinates. Fixed by separating into 2 rows (expanded at y=PAD, collapsed at y=PAD+800+GAP).

### Claude · 2026-05-29 07:29

Ahora lo tengo todo claro. La lógica de filtrado del código:

```
matchesStatus(row, chip):
  "todos"      → muestra todo
  "pagados"    → cobrado > 0  AND  pendiente === 0
  "pendientes" → pendiente > 0
  "vencidos"   → placeholder (devuelve false, necesita lógica de fechas)
```

---

**El problema para Figma:** Figma no puede filtrar datos reales. Pero sí podemos **prototipar la interacción** de forma convincente.

La solución es crear **4 frames de tabla** — uno por cada estado del filtro — con las filas correctas según la lógica, y conectarlos con Smart Animate en los chips:

| Chip activo | Filas visibles |
|---|---|
| Todos | 5 filas mixtas |
| Pagados | Solo filas con badge "Pagado" |
| Pendientes | Solo filas con badge "Pendiente" |
| Vencidos | 0 filas (o 1 ejemplo) |

Para hacerlo bien a nivel atómico, primero necesito actualizar el componente `Filter/Chip` para que coincida con la referencia (negro activo, punto de color, pill shape), y luego montar los 4 estados de tabla.

**Icon fix code (canonical pattern):**
```javascript
function fixIconInstance(inst) {
  if (inst.fills && inst.fills.length > 0) {
    inst.fills = [];
  }
  inst.opacity = 1;
  const queue = [...inst.children];
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const node = queue.shift();
    if (node.type === "VECTOR" || node.type === "BOOLEAN_OPERATION") {
      if (node.fills && node.fills.length > 0) {
        node.fills = [{ type: "SOLID", color: { r: 1, g: 1, b: 1 }, opacity: 1, visible: true, blendMode: "NORMAL" }];
      }
    }
    if ("children" in node) queue.push(...node.children);
  }
}
```

**CHANGE_TO reaction format (correct — plural `actions`):**
```javascript
function changeTo(destinationId) {
  return {
    trigger: { type: "ON_CLICK" },
    actions: [{
      type: "NODE",
      destinationId,
      navigation: "CHANGE_TO",
      transition: { type: "SMART_ANIMATE", easing: { type: "EASE_IN_AND_OUT" }, duration: 0.3 },
      preserveScrollPosition: false
    }]
  };
}
```

const ACTIVE_BG = [{ type: "SOLID", color: { r: 1, g: 1, b: 1 }, opacity: 0.12, blendMode: "NORMAL", visible: true }];
function markActive(subitem, active) {
  subitem.fills = active ? ACTIVE_BG : [];
  subitem.strokes = active
    ? [{ type: "SOLID", color: { r: 0.31, g: 0.65, b: 1 }, opacity: 1, blendMode: "NORMAL" }]
    : [];
  if (active) {
    subitem.strokeWeight = 2; subitem.strokeAlign = "INSIDE";
    subitem.strokeLeftWeight = 2; subitem.strokeRightWeight = 0;
    subitem.strokeTopWeight = 0; subitem.strokeBottomWeight = 0;
  }
}

4. Errors and Fixes:

- **First icon fix made icons into white rectangles**: The `fixNode()` function set fills on RECTANGLE nodes inside icons (bounding box), covering the actual vector shapes. **Fix**: Rewrote as `fixIconInstance()` — removes fills from INSTANCE level, sets only VECTOR/BOOLEAN_OPERATION node fills to white.

- **`action` vs `actions` in reactions**: Error: "Please update the `actions` field instead of the `action` field in order to prevent data loss." **Fix**: Changed reaction format from `action: {...}` to `actions: [{...}]` (plural array).

- **Self-referential Pagos reaction**: Setting Pagos NavItem reaction pointing to its own parent variant (1520:610) caused error "destination node was rejected — source may not be a valid prototype source." **Fix**: Removed Pagos self-referential reaction entirely.

- **`layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` before insertion**: Error: "FILL can only be set on children of auto-layout frames." **Fix**: Insert node into parent FIRST via `insertChild()`, then set FILL sizing.

- **Accordion variant heights auto-shrinking**: When sections collapse, `primaryAxisSizingMode = "AUTO"` made the sidebar shrink to content (478px, 622px, 334px). **Fix**: Set `primaryAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"` and `resize(220, 766)` on all 3 accordion variants.

- **`clipsContent = false` on all expanded variants**: Caused visual overflow — content from one section bleeding into adjacent areas. **Fix**: Set `clipsContent = true` on all 10 expanded variants.

- **Accordion variants overlapping existing variants in component set**: When added, v2/v3/v4 were positioned at x=300/560/820 — SAME positions as Overview/Students/Cohorts. Screenshots captured the top-most variant at each position, making v5/v6/v7 appear to show the wrong accordion states. **Fix**: Moved accordion variants to x=1860/2120/2380 (to the right of Analytics).

- **Figma auto-assigning Sections property values**: When "Sections" property was added to some variants, Figma assigned values to other variants based on position, causing v5=ProductoClosed, v6=PLClosed, v7=BothClosed visual states. **Fix**: Added "Sections=Open" suffix to all non-accordion variant names.

- **Phosphor icons**: Found the full library at `611:148` on `04- COMPONENTES` page. Cannot use `importComponentByKeyAsync` for these (local components). Must use `getNodeByIdAsync(id)` with specific IDs.
- **Auto-layout sizing**: `createAutoLayout()` > `createFrame() + layoutMode`. Setting `counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"` needed for components to maintain fixed height in parent auto-layout.
- **Component set bounds**: Variants at positions outside the component set's reported width are invisible. Must move them to visible positions and resize the set.

## Auditoría completa — Navigation/Sidebar v2

---

### 🔴 CRÍTICO (funcionalidad rota)

**1. Sin prototype reactions en las 17 variantes**
Ningún variant tiene interacciones de prototipo configuradas (`reactions: []` en todos). Los acordeones (abrir/cerrar Producto/P&L), la navegación entre estados y los hovers no funcionan. El sidebar es estático en el prototipo.

**2. 3 variantes acordeón a 900px (deberían ser 800px)**
`ProductoClosed`, `PLClosed` y `BothClosed` tienen height=900. Solo se corrigieron los 7 Open variants, no los acordeones. Al usarlos como instancia tendrán 100px de espacio vacío al fondo.

---

### 🟡 DEUDA DE DISEÑO (inconsistencias de sistema)

**3. 58 espaciados hardcodeados**
Todo el padding e itemSpacing usa valores numéricos literales (8px, 12px, 16px, 20px) en lugar de variables de `02 · Spacing` (`space/2`, `space/3`, `space/4`…). Si el sistema de espaciado cambia, el sidebar no se actualiza.

**4. 21 textos sin text style aplicado**
Todos los nodos TEXT tienen `fontSize`, `fontWeight` y `lineHeight` hardcodeados en lugar de un estilo de texto del archivo (`Label-2`, `Label-3`, `Body-3`…). No existe conexión entre el sidebar y el sistema tipográfico.

**5. 16 fills de iconos hardcodeados** (dentro de instancias Phosphor)
Los `Vector` dentro de los iconos Phosphor (`CaretLineDown`, `GraduationCap`, `Buildings`, etc.) tienen `#ffffff` hardcoded. No pueden modificarse desde el sidebar — hay que intervenir en el componente fuente de cada icono Phosphor.

**6. 1 border radius hardcodeado**
Un nodo tiene `cornerRadius` con valor numérico literal sin usar variable de la colección `03 · Radius`.

---

### 🔵 CALIDAD DE COMPONENTE (mejoras estructurales)

**7. Inconsistencia de altura entre filas**
- Nav items (`subitem`): **36px**
- Configuración (`config-item`): **44px**
- NavItem Pagos (instancia): **44px**

El item de Configuración y el de Pagos son 8px más altos que el resto de los items de nav. No hay una altura estándar de fila.

**8. Sin component properties funcionales**
Solo existen las 3 propiedades de variante (`ActiveSection`, `Collapsed`, `Sections`). No hay:
- `BOOLEAN` para mostrar/ocultar el footer
- `BOOLEAN` para mostrar/ocultar la sección Configuración
- `TEXT` para el nombre de la app ("Atlas")
- `INSTANCE_SWAP` para cambiar el avatar del usuario
Cualquier personalización requiere crear una variante nueva.

**9. Sin propiedades en el NavItem component** (instancia de Pagos)
El NavItem no expone su texto ni icono como properties del sidebar, por lo que "Pagos" no puede cambiarse sin ir al componente fuente.

4. Errors and Fixes:

- **`setBoundVariableForPaint` loses fill opacity**: All fills became opacity=1.0, causing white backgrounds on active row frames. Fixed by manually passing the desired opacity in the base paint object passed to `setBoundVariableForPaint`.

- **White rectangles in active states**: `subitem` FRAME backgrounds (active row overlays) showed as fully white because `setBoundVariableForPaint` lost their opacity. Also `config-item` FRAME. Fixed by re-running a targeted script that explicitly set opacity=0.08 for these frames using overlay-08 variable.

- **Variants at 900px instead of 800px**: After `setExplicitVariableModeForCollection`, all Open variants changed to 900px. Fixed by forcing `primaryAxisSizingMode = 'FIXED'` and `resize(220, 800)` on all Open variants.

- **Accordion variants also at 900px**: Separate fix needed for ProductoClosed, PLClosed, BothClosed.

- **Prototype reactions `action` vs `actions`**: Error "Please update the `actions` field instead of the `action` field". Fixed by using `actions: [{ type: 'NODE', ... }]` (plural array).

- **Prototype reactions "destination rejected"**: Error on first attempt for accordion variants. This attempt was abandoned. Later reactions script (for Open variants) ran successfully with 226 reactions.

- **Variable name "space/0.5" invalid**: Figma rejected the name. Fixed by using "space/xxs" instead.

- **`createVariable` then `codeSyntax` assignment**: "no setter for property". Fixed by removing `codeSyntax` assignment line.

- **`findAll` callback crashing on `overflowDirection`**: TEXT nodes don't have this property. Fixed by removing that check from audit script.

- **`layoutMode` not on TEXT node**: `auditSpacing` function traversed into TEXT nodes. Fixed by adding `FRAME_TYPES.has(node.type)` guard.

- **`config-item` FRAME with white fill at opacity 1.0**: Found after initial fix — this node was named differently from "subitem" so it was missed by the first pass. Fixed with a broader search for full-width row frames with bright fills.

### Claude · 2026-06-02 07:22

Aquí va el análisis completo. Siendo honesto y práctico sobre lo que se podría mejorar en el componente actual:

---

## Mejoras posibles en Navigation/Sidebar v2

### 🔴 Crítico (reglas High/Critical del skill)

**1. Touch targets demasiado pequeños**
Los `subitem` miden **36px de alto** y los `section-header` **40px** — ambos por debajo del mínimo de 44px (Apple HIG) / 48dp (Material). Solo el `NavItem` standalone (44px) cumple. Si el sidebar se usa en tablet/touch, hay un problema de usabilidad real.
> Regla: `touch-target-size`

**2. Sin estado hover definido**
No existe ninguna variante ni estado de hover para los subitems. En web admin, el hover es feedback crítico antes de hacer click. El usuario no sabe que algo es clickeable sin probarlo.
> Regla: `hover-vs-tap` + `state-clarity`

**3. Estado activo demasiado sutil**
El active usa `overlay-08` = blanco al 8% sobre fondo oscuro → diferencia visual muy pequeña. Para un estado **permanente** (no transitorio), el contraste debería ser mayor (12–20%). El hover suele ser 8%, el selected debería ser más notorio.
> Regla: `state-clarity` + `color-accessible-pairs`

---

### 🟠 Importante (Navigation + Accessibility)

**4. Sin iconos en los items de navegación**
Todos los subitems son texto puro. Los patrones de admin con sidebar recomiendan **icono + texto** para mejorar escaneo visual y reconocimiento. Actualmente si el sidebar está colapsado y solo tienes 56px, ¿qué se muestra? ¿Solo texto truncado?
> Regla: `nav-label-icon`

**5. Sin affordance de accordion (sin chevron)**
Los `section-header` de Producto y P&L no tienen ningún indicador visual de que son expandibles/colapsables. Un chevron rotando es el estándar. Sin él, el usuario descubre la funcionalidad por accidente.
> Regla: `state-clarity` + `progressive-disclosure`

**6. El botón toggle (←) es icon-only sin label**
El botón de colapsar sidebar tiene solo el icono de flecha. Necesita un label accesible (tooltip o aria-label). En Figma, la propiedad de componente podría exponer esto.
> Regla: `aria-labels`

---

### 🟡 Mejoras de calidad

**7. 8 nuevas secciones sin variante Collapsed**
Calendario, Profesores, Empresas, TimeTracking, Academy, Ventures, Business y Evolve no tienen `Collapsed=True`. Si el usuario navega a esas secciones y colapsa el sidebar, el prototype cae en un estado indefinido.

**8. Avatar como touch target pequeño**
El avatar mide 32×32px. Si fuera clickeable (perfil de usuario, cambio de cuenta), estaría 12px por debajo del mínimo. Habría que agregar padding invisible o hacerlo 44px.
> Regla: `touch-target-size`

**9. UserRole sin distinción visual**
"Finance Admin" y "Iria Ramos" tienen jerarquía visual muy similar (ambos texto pequeño). El rol podría llevar un badge/pill o color secundario más diferenciado para escanear el perfil más rápido.
> Regla: `visual-hierarchy` + `weight-hierarchy`

**10. Sin scroll indicator si el contenido desborda**
Con 12 subitems + headers + footer en 800px funciona, pero si la altura de pantalla fuera menor, los items del final quedan cortados sin ninguna señal de que hay más contenido.
> Regla: `scroll-behavior`

---

### Resumen de impacto

| # | Mejora | Impacto | Esfuerzo |
|---|--------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Subir altura subitems a 44px | Alto | Bajo |
| 2 | Añadir estado hover | Alto | Medio |
| 3 | Reforzar active state (12-16%) | Medio | Bajo |
| 4 | Añadir iconos a nav items | Alto | Alto |
| 5 | Chevron en section headers | Medio | Bajo |
| 6 | Label en botón toggle | Bajo | Bajo |
| 7 | Collapsed variants para 8 nuevas | Medio | Medio |
| 8 | Avatar hit area | Bajo | Bajo |
| 9 | Badge/pill para role | Bajo | Bajo |
| 10 | Scroll indicator | Bajo | Medio |

### Claude · 2026-06-02 10:32

El frame collapsed funciona perfectamente — sidebar de 56px a la izquierda con `→` para expandir, contenido más ancho. Resumen de todo lo que se ha hecho:

---

**✅ 1. ShowConfig** — propiedad BOOLEAN linked en todos los 43 variants. Poner en `false` oculta Configuración.

**✅ 2. Accordion con contexto** — 12 variantes nuevas (43 total):
- Si estás en **Programas** y colapas P&L → `Programas + PLClosed` (Programas sigue activo)
- Si estás en **Academy** y colapas Producto → `Academy + ProductoClosed` (Academy sigue activo)

**✅ 3. Toggle en prototipo** — 14 frames collapsed (56px) + 196 reacciones:
- `←` en pantalla Open → navega al collapsed correspondiente
- `→` en pantalla Collapsed → vuelve al Open correspondiente
- Clicks en iconos del collapsed → navegan entre collapsed frames

---

**⚠️ 4. Hover — no es implementable tal como está**

El sidebar usa FRAMES inline (no instancias de NavItem/v3). Para que funcione el hover necesitas `WHILE_HOVERING` + `CHANGE_TO`, pero eso requeriría **43 × 14 = 602 variantes hover** (una por cada item por pantalla). No es viable.

**La solución correcta sería** reconstruir los items del sidebar como instancias del componente `NavItem/v3` (que sí tiene `State=Hover`). Cada instancia gestionaría su propio hover de forma independiente. Es un refactor de la arquitectura interna del sidebar, no un parche.

¿Quieres que lo refactorice así?

4. Errors and fixes:

- **Accordion variants outside component set bounds**: Variants at x=1860, 2120, 2380 were outside the component set width (1860px). Fixed by moving to y=1720 (third row) and resizing component set to 2560px height.

- **Height inconsistency**: Payments Open (v1) was 766px while all other Open variants were 800px. Fixed by resizing `1520:610` to 800px. Also resized 3 accordion variants from 766→800px.

- **`importComponentByKeyAsync` fails for local icons**: Error "Component with key not found" when trying to import Phosphor icons. Fixed: used `getNodeByIdAsync(id)` with specific component IDs found by inspecting node `611:148`.

- **Filter chips "muy finas" (too thin)**: New chips (36px, 12px font, 12px padding) looked thinner than originals (40px, 13px font, 16px padding). Fixed by reverting to original specs and setting `counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"` + `resize(w, 40)`.

- **Chip instances stuck at 16px height**: Instances in filter bar showed height=16 instead of 40px. Fixed by setting `counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"` on component variants AND `layoutSizingVertical = "FIXED"` + `resize(w, 40)` on each instance.

- **`createFrame()` + `layoutMode = "VERTICAL"` not auto-sizing**: nav-groups stayed at 40px. Fixed by replacing `createFrame()` + manual layoutMode with `figma.createAutoLayout("VERTICAL")`.

- **Table/FilterBar organism created unnecessarily**: User pointed out that Filter/Chip atoms should go directly in the screen without a wrapper organism. Deleted `Table/FilterBar` component and replaced with individual chip instances.

- **Card/stat text overridden by shared TEXT property**: When linking all variants to the same TEXT property, setting one changed all others. Fixed by unlinking (`componentPropertyReferences = {}`) and using static per-variant text.

5. Problem Solving:

- **Atomic design enforcement**: Learned to always modify master components first; screens update automatically via instances. User explicitly stated this as a rule.
- **Phosphor icons**: Found the full library at `611:148` on `04- COMPONENTES` page. Cannot use `importComponentByKeyAsync` for these (local components). Must use `getNodeByIdAsync(id)` with specific IDs.
- **Auto-layout sizing**: `createAutoLayout()` > `createFrame() + layoutMode`. Setting `counterAxisSizingMode = "FIXED"` needed for components to maintain fixed height in parent auto-layout.
- **Component set bounds**: Variants at positions outside the component set's reported width are invisible. Must move them to visible positions and resize the set.

Tengo los datos. Aquí está el informe exhaustivo:

---

## Auditoría completa — Navigation/Sidebar v2

---

### 🔴 CRÍTICO (funcionalidad rota)

**1. Sin prototype reactions en las 17 variantes**
Ningún variant tiene interacciones de prototipo configuradas (`reactions: []` en todos). Los acordeones (abrir/cerrar Producto/P&L), la navegación entre estados y los hovers no funcionan. El sidebar es estático en el prototipo.

**2. 3 variantes acordeón a 900px (deberían ser 800px)**
`ProductoClosed`, `PLClosed` y `BothClosed` tienen height=900. Solo se corrigieron los 7 Open variants, no los acordeones. Al usarlos como instancia tendrán 100px de espacio vacío al fondo.

---

### 🟡 DEUDA DE DISEÑO (inconsistencias de sistema)

**3. 58 espaciados hardcodeados**
Todo el padding e itemSpacing usa valores numéricos literales (8px, 12px, 16px, 20px) en lugar de variables de `02 · Spacing` (`space/2`, `space/3`, `space/4`…). Si el sistema de espaciado cambia, el sidebar no se actualiza.

**4. 21 textos sin text style aplicado**
Todos los nodos TEXT tienen `fontSize`, `fontWeight` y `lineHeight` hardcodeados en lugar de un estilo de texto del archivo (`Label-2`, `Label-3`, `Body-3`…). No existe conexión entre el sidebar y el sistema tipográfico.

**5. 16 fills de iconos hardcodeados** (dentro de instancias Phosphor)
Los `Vector` dentro de los iconos Phosphor (`CaretLineDown`, `GraduationCap`, `Buildings`, etc.) tienen `#ffffff` hardcoded. No pueden modificarse desde el sidebar — hay que intervenir en el componente fuente de cada icono Phosphor.

**6. 1 border radius hardcodeado**
Un nodo tiene `cornerRadius` con valor numérico literal sin usar variable de la colección `03 · Radius`.

---

### 🔵 CALIDAD DE COMPONENTE (mejoras estructurales)

**7. Inconsistencia de altura entre filas**
- Nav items (`subitem`): **36px**
- Configuración (`config-item`): **44px**
- NavItem Pagos (instancia): **44px**

El item de Configuración y el de Pagos son 8px más altos que el resto de los items de nav. No hay una altura estándar de fila.

**8. Sin component properties funcionales**
Solo existen las 3 propiedades de variante (`ActiveSection`, `Collapsed`, `Sections`). No hay:
- `BOOLEAN` para mostrar/ocultar el footer
- `BOOLEAN` para mostrar/ocultar la sección Configuración
- `TEXT` para el nombre de la app ("Atlas")
- `INSTANCE_SWAP` para cambiar el avatar del usuario
Cualquier personalización requiere crear una variante nueva.

**9. Sin propiedades en el NavItem component** (instancia de Pagos)
El NavItem no expone su texto ni icono como properties del sidebar, por lo que "Pagos" no puede cambiarse sin ir al componente fuente.

---

### ⚪ LO QUE ESTÁ BIEN

| Check | Estado |
|---|---|
| Colores hardcodeados (no-instancias) | ✅ 0 restantes |
| Dark mode forzado en el component set | ✅ |
| Alturas de los 7 Open variants | ✅ 800px |
| Anchuras de los 7 Collapsed variants | ✅ 56px |
| Nodos sin nombre | ✅ 0 |
| Variants fuera de bounds del component set | ✅ 0 |
| Textos truncados | ✅ 0 |

---

¿Por cuál quieres que empiece? Lo más impactante sería los **prototipos (#1)** y el **height de los acordeones (#2)**.

## 2. Key Technical Concepts

- **Figma Plugin API** via `use_figma` on file `4Xr4LqAex3uqalsh97oD7L`, page "componentes v2"
- **`combineAsVariants()`** — creates COMPONENT_SET from array of COMPONENT nodes
- **`createInstance()`** — creates an instance from a COMPONENT node (not importable from external library by key; must use `getNodeByIdAsync` to get the component first)
- **`swapComponent()`** — swaps the main component of an existing instance (must re-apply vector fill overrides after swap)
- **`insertChild(idx, node)`** — inserts a node at a specific index in a parent's children
- **`setBoundVariableForPaint()`** — binds a variable to a fill/stroke paint (opacity must be explicit in the base paint)
- **`setExplicitVariableModeForCollection()`** — forces Dark mode on components
- **Prototype reactions format**:
  ```javascript
  [{
    actions: [{ type: 'NODE', destinationId: id, navigation: 'CHANGE_TO'|'NAVIGATE', transition: {...} }],
    trigger: { type: 'ON_CLICK'|'ON_HOVER' }
  }]
  ```
- **`ON_HOVER` trigger** (NOT `WHILE_HOVERING` which is invalid in Plugin API)
- **`componentPropertyReferences`** — links text/visible properties: `{ characters: propKey }` or `{ visible: propKey }`
- **`addComponentProperty(name, type, defaultValue)`** — adds TEXT, BOOLEAN, or INSTANCE_SWAP property to component set
- **`setProperties({propKey: value})`** — sets component property on an instance
- **Auto-layout**: `primaryAxisSizingMode = 'FIXED'|'AUTO'` (NOT 'HUG' — that's invalid; use 'AUTO' for frame's own axis, `layoutSizingHorizontal/Vertical = 'FILL'|'HUG'|'FIXED'` for children)
- **`figma.createAutoLayout('VERTICAL')`** — creates auto-layout frame with HUG sizing on both axes
- **Dark mode forcing**: semantic collection `VariableCollectionId:289:3`, Dark mode ID `289:1`

```javascript
const baseComp = isActive ? NAV_ACTIVE : NAV_DEFAULT;
const inst = baseComp.createInstance();
inst.name = rowName;
const labelNode = inst.findOne(n => n.name === 'label' && n.type === 'TEXT');
if (labelNode) labelNode.characters = labelText;
// Swap icon and reset fill after swap
const iconInst = inst.findOne(n => n.name === 'icon' && n.type === 'INSTANCE');
if (iconInst) {
  iconInst.swapComponent(iconComp);
  const vecs = iconInst.findAllWithCriteria({ types: ['VECTOR'] });
  for (const v of vecs) v.fills = [solidFill(isActive ? textPrimary : textSecondary, isActive ? 1.0 : 0.6)];
}
// Insert at same position
const idx = [...parent.children].indexOf(row);
parent.insertChild(idx, inst);
row.remove();
// Reactions with ON_HOVER + ON_CLICK
inst.reactions = [
  { actions: [{ type: 'NODE', destinationId: NAV_HOVER.id, navigation: 'CHANGE_TO', transition: null }], trigger: { type: 'ON_HOVER' } },
  ...(destId ? [{ actions: [{ type: 'NODE', destinationId: destId, navigation: 'CHANGE_TO', transition: TRANSITION }], trigger: { type: 'ON_CLICK' } }] : [])
];
```

**deactivateRow pattern** (for double-active bug):
```javascript
function deactivateRow(variant, rowName) {
  const row = variant.findOne(n => n.name === rowName);
  row.fills = []; // clear active fill
  const icon = row.findOne(n => n.name === 'icon' && n.type === 'INSTANCE');
  if (icon) icon.findAllWithCriteria({ types: ['VECTOR'] }).forEach(v => v.fills = [solidFill(textSecondaryVar, 0.6)]);
  const txt = row.findOne(n => n.name === 'label' && n.type === 'TEXT');
  if (txt) txt.fills = [solidFill(textSecondaryVar, 0.7)];
}
```

## 4. Errors and Fixes

- **`primaryAxisSizingMode = 'HUG'` invalid**: Error "Invalid enum value. Expected 'FIXED' | 'AUTO'". Fix: use `'AUTO'` for frame's own sizing mode; use `layoutSizingVertical = 'HUG'` for children sizing.

- **`importComponentByKeyAsync` fails for Phosphor icons**: They're in external libraries and the key lookup fails. Fix: use `figma.getNodeByIdAsync(nodeId)` with the icon's node ID from existing instances in the file, then call `createInstance()`.

- **`addComponentProperty('Icon', 'INSTANCE_SWAP', key)` fails**: "Property value is incompatible with component property type". External library component keys are rejected as INSTANCE_SWAP defaults. Fix: skip the Icon INSTANCE_SWAP property, only add Label TEXT property.

- **Double-active bug (Pagos active in all screens)**: All 13 non-Pagos clones had Pagos active because clones started from the Pagos-active master and `activateRow()` only added active state without deactivating Pagos. Fix: `deactivateRow(variant, 'Pagos')` on all 13 non-Pagos Open variants.

- **Prototype reactions failed with first attempt**: Error "destination rejected" (for `2091:1264` Facturación). The reactions script ran AFTER `addComponentProperty` in the same script, causing validation issues. Fix: run reactions in a SEPARATE script call with no property additions.

- **Accordion non-independent**: Clicking any section header went to Pagos-accordion variants, losing context. Fix: built 12 new context-aware accordion variants + 4-state matrix.

- **`WHILE_HOVERING` trigger invalid**: Error "Expected trigger to be one of: ON_CLICK | ON_HOVER | ON_PRESS...". Fix: use `{ type: 'ON_HOVER' }` instead.

- **Facturación reactions rejected (minor)**: `2091:1264` and `2092:1453` rejected when source is a NavItem INSTANCE (not a frame). 2 errors out of 514 replacements — likely due to special character `ó` in variant name. Accepted as minor limitation.

- **`layout error` → user-info**: `primaryAxisSizingMode = 'HUG'` invalid. Fix: use `figma.createAutoLayout('VERTICAL')` for user-info frame, then `layoutSizingHorizontal = 'FILL'`.

---

## 5. Problem Solving

- **Hover architecture**: Instead of 602 sidebar hover variants (infeasible), refactored to use NavItem/v3 instances inside the sidebar. Each instance inherits `ON_HOVER` from the component and gets its own `ON_CLICK CHANGE_TO` override. This gives native hover feedback at the atom level.

- **Icon swap after `swapComponent()`**: After swapping, vector fills reset to component defaults. Fixed by always re-applying `solidFill(colorVar, opacity)` to all vector children after every swap.

- **Accordion with context**: The 3 original accordion variants were all `ActiveSection=Pagos`, causing loss of active context when toggling. Created 12 context-specific variants (8 PLClosed + 4 ProductoClosed). Wired transitions so Producto items active → PLClosed keeps Producto visible; P&L items active → ProductoClosed keeps P&L visible.

- **Prototype frame navigation vs component variant switching**: Used `CHANGE_TO` for component-level reactions (sidebar variants switching within same frame context) and `NAVIGATE` for prototype-level reactions (navigating between full screen frames).

### Claude · 2026-06-02 11:07

Con ambas versiones analizadas, hago la crítica completa:

---

## 🔍 Critique de Composición — Híbrido Propuesto

---

### BALANCE — `minor issue`

**Observación:** Ambas versiones tienen peso visual concentrado en la izquierda, con los chevrons como único contrapeso derecho. La propuesta híbrida añade un indicador izquierdo (border 3px) **Y** indentación de 16px en los items.

**Problema:** Dos señales de jerarquía izquierda compitiendo — la indentación ya crea separación visual entre header y children; añadir encima un left border duplica la señal sin añadir información. El ojo recibe dos affordances para el mismo concepto.

**Fix:** Elegir UNO. El left border funciona mejor sin indentación porque el border ES el indicador de jerarquía. La indentación + border juntos es over-design.

---

### WHITESPACE — `major issue`

**Observación:** En un sidebar de 220px, una indentación de 16px consume el 7% del ancho en un elemento que no es interactivo. Los separadores horizontales del v3 van de borde a borde, pero los items indentados crearían un eje de alineación en x=16 que rompe con esa continuidad.

**Problema:** El separador horizontal (full-width) y los items indentados crean dos sistemas de borde izquierdo inconsistentes. El ojo los lee como "¿por qué este elemento empieza aquí y ese otro allá?". Fragmentación del grid interno.

**Fix:** Si los items están indentados, los separadores deben empezar también en x=16. Pero eso se ve raro. Solución real: no usar indentación, y usar jerarquía tipográfica en su lugar.

---

### RHYTHM — `minor issue`

**Observación:** v3 tiene ritmo impecable — 44px por fila, constante. v2 también. El problema surge cuando section headers (44px, texto normal) y nav items (44px, texto normal + indent) tienen el mismo peso visual.

**Problema:** Si el section header y los items tienen la misma altura y apariencia tipográfica, el header parece otro item navegable más, no un label de agrupación. La diferencia solo por color/opacity es débil a 220px de ancho.

**Fix:** Section headers en `text-xs uppercase tracking-widest` con opacidad 40-50% — el patrón que usan Linear, Vercel, Notion. Crea variación de ritmo que señala "esto es un label" sin romper el spacing scale.

---

### GESTALT — `major issue`

**Observación (Continuity):** La alineación flush-left del v3 crea una línea vertical continua por el borde izquierdo. La indentación rompe esa línea, fragmentando el flujo vertical del ojo.

**Observación (Proximity):** En v2, Pagos (sin indentación) y los section headers comparten el mismo x=0, implicando visualmente que están al mismo nivel jerárquico. Pero no lo están — Pagos es una ruta, Product/P&L son grupos. Esto confunde la estructura.

**Problema:** La indentación para crear jerarquía también equipara involuntariamente Pagos con los section headers por posición.

**Fix:** Sin indentación. Diferenciación por tipografía en section headers + left border en active item. Pagos en una sección claramente separada (ya lo está con el separator del v3).

---

## ✅ Spec revisada tras la crítica

| Elemento | Original propuesto | Revisado |
|---|---|---|
| Indentación items | ✅ 16px | ❌ Eliminada |
| Left border activo | ✅ 3px en x=16 | ✅ 3px en x=0 (borde sidebar) |
| Section headers | Igual que ahora | **Uppercase, 11px, opacity 45%** |
| Active overlay | Mayor que 16% | **8% blanco** + semi-bold label |
| Active bg | Sólido v2 | Left border + overlay sutil |
| Todo lo demás v3 | ✓ | ✓ |

**El resultado:** jerarquía clara sin romper la continuidad vertical. Active state visible sin ruido. Section headers que se leen como labels, no items.
